scientific_limitations: Finite result guarantees existence of a one-exception balanced-tail maximizer, not uniqueness of all finite optimizers. Eventual uniqueness assumes fixed species count, positive limiting sample fraction outside reciprocal integers, and exact uniform sampling without replacement. It does not address ecological estimation error, growing species richness, or unsampled abundance distributions.
title: Exact singleton-rarefaction envelope and the dominant-species staircase
